evidence.quote: I led a strategy to redesign a promising hydrogel cancer therapy to treat metastatic disease—addressing a critical clinical limitation: its dependence on local injection. To enable systemic delivery with tumor-specific activation, I proposed a novel mechanism using tumor-overexpressed matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) as biological triggers. I helped design a cleavable peptide linker that allowed two nanoparticles to assemble into a hydrogel only in the tumor microenvironment. This innovation transformed a localized treatment into a systemically viable platform.
evidence.context: Concrete example of creative problem-solving: identified limitation (local injection only), proposed novel mechanism (MMP-triggered assembly), achieved transformative outcome (localized → systemic treatment). This is mechanism-driven innovation, not just incremental improvement.

evidence.quote: Developing a targeted lipid nanoparticle (LNP)-based platform for a novel in vivo immune cell engineering strategy to enhance the therapeutic efficacy of mRNA cancer vaccines
evidence.context: Novel approach to immune cell engineering - in vivo reprogramming rather than ex vivo manipulation. Shows creative thinking in therapeutic strategy.
